v3-4.candidate: In his deeds he was like a lion, like a young lion roaring for prey.
v3-4.close: In his deeds he was like a lion, like a young lion roaring over prey.
v3-4.display:
In his deeds he was like a lion,
like a young lion roaring for prey.

v3-5.display:
He searched out and pursued the lawless,
and burned those who troubled his people.

v3-8.display:
He passed through the cities of Judah,
destroyed the ungodly out of her,
and turned wrath away from Israel.

v3-9.display:
His name reached to the end of the earth,
and he gathered those who were perishing.

v3-45.display:
Jerusalem was uninhabited like a wilderness.
None of those born in her went in or out;
the sanctuary was being trampled,
and foreigners were in the citadel, a lodging for the nations.
Delight was removed from Jacob,
and flute and lyre ceased.

v3-50.display:
They cried aloud to Heaven, saying,
“What shall we do with these,
and where shall we take them,

v3-51.display:
when Thy holy places have been trampled and profaned,
and Thy priests are in mourning and humiliation?

v3-52.display:
Behold! The nations have gathered against us to destroy us.
Thou knowest what they are planning against us.
